Poniżej znajduje się konfiguracja początkowa (która jest ukryta w raporcie):
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
df <- read.csv("breast_cancer_data.csv")

str(df)

dim_df <- dim(df)
print(paste("Liczba wierszy:", dim_df[1], "| Liczba kolumn:", dim_df[2]))

head(df, 10)
tail(df, 5)
```

```{r}
df <- df %>% select(-id, -starts_with("X"))

df$diagnosis <- as.factor(df$diagnosis)

colnames(df) <- toupper(colnames(df))

# Wygenerowanie 3 sztucznych braków danych (NA)
df$RADIUS_MEAN[c(5, 15, 25)] <- NA

df_sorted <- df %>% arrange(desc(AREA_MEAN))

df_filtered <- df %>% filter(DIAGNOSIS == "M" & RADIUS_MEAN > 20)
```

```{r}
print(paste("Liczba NA przed imputacją:", sum(is.na(df$RADIUS_MEAN))))

mean_radius <- mean(df$RADIUS_MEAN, na.rm = TRUE)
df$RADIUS_MEAN[is.na(df$RADIUS_MEAN)] <- mean_radius

print(paste("Liczba NA po imputacji:", sum(is.na(df$RADIUS_MEAN))))
```

```{r}
eda_summary <- df %>%
  filter(TEXTURE_MEAN > 10) %>%                        
  select(DIAGNOSIS, RADIUS_MEAN, AREA_MEAN) %>%   
  mutate(AREA_TO_RADIUS_RATIO = AREA_MEAN / RADIUS_MEAN) %>% 
  group_by(DIAGNOSIS) %>%                     
  summarise(                       
    AVG_RADIUS = mean(RADIUS_MEAN),
    MAX_AREA = max(AREA_MEAN),
    COUNT = n()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(AVG_RADIUS))                       

print(eda_summary)
```

```{r}
get_mode <- function(v) {
  uniqv <- unique(v)
  uniqv[which.max(tabulate(match(v, uniqv)))]
}

stats_area <- list(
  Minimum = min(df$AREA_MEAN),
  Maksimum = max(df$AREA_MEAN),
  Srednia = mean(df$AREA_MEAN),
  Mediana = median(df$AREA_MEAN),
  Moda = get_mode(df$AREA_MEAN),
  Odchylenie_Standardowe = sd(df$AREA_MEAN),
  Kwartyle = quantile(df$AREA_MEAN)
)
print(stats_area)

freq_table <- table(df$DIAGNOSIS)
print("Tabela częstości (B - Benign, M - Malignant):")
print(freq_table)
```


```{r}
t_test_result <- t.test(RADIUS_MEAN ~ DIAGNOSIS, data = df)
print(t_test_result)
```

```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = DIAGNOSIS, y = AREA_MEAN, fill = DIAGNOSIS)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("B" = "#1b9e77", "M" = "#d95f02")) +
  labs(title = "Rozkład powierzchni guza według diagnozy",
       x = "Diagnoza", y = "Średnia Powierzchnia (Area Mean)") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(df, aes(x = RADIUS_MEAN, fill = DIAGNOSIS)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("B" = "#1b9e77", "M" = "#d95f02")) +
  labs(title = "Wykres gęstości dla promienia guza",
       x = "Średni Promień (Radius Mean)", y = "Gęstość") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(df, aes(x = RADIUS_MEAN, y = TEXTURE_MEAN, color = DIAGNOSIS)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("B" = "#1b9e77", "M" = "#d95f02")) +
  labs(title = "Zależność między promieniem a teksturą",
       x = "Średni Promień", y = "Średnia Tekstura") +
  theme_minimal()
```
  
```{r}
filter_by_threshold <- function(data, column_name, threshold) {
  result <- data[data[[column_name]] > threshold, ]
  return(result)
}

high_perimeter_data <- filter_by_threshold(df, "PERIMETER_MEAN", 100)
print(paste("Liczba pacjentów z Perimeter Mean > 100:", nrow(high_perimeter_data)))
```

```{r}
linear_model <- lm(AREA_MEAN ~ PERIMETER_MEAN, data = df)

summary(linear_model)

ggplot(df, aes(x = PERIMETER_MEAN, y = AREA_MEAN)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "darkblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "Regresja liniowa: Powierzchnia a Obwód guza",
       x = "Obwód (Perimeter Mean)",
       y = "Powierzchnia (Area Mean)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
